description: Defines the em_cmd_exec_t class, which manages command execution, SSL context, and network operations for Wi-Fi mesh commands in a network management system.

classes.name: em_cmd_exec_t
classes.description: Class managing command execution, SSL context, and network communication for Wi-Fi mesh commands.

methods.name: get_ep_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the edited network node address (virtual, returns NULL by default).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the command object.

methods.name: get_ssl_ctx
methods.description: Returns the current SSL context.

methods.name: get_event
methods.description: Returns the current event associated with the command.

methods.name: get_event_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the current event.

methods.name: get_event_data_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the event data.

methods.name: set_event_data_length
methods.description: Sets the length of the event data.

methods.name: get_cmd
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the command object.

methods.name: get_param
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the command parameters.

methods.name: get_type
methods.description: Returns the command type.

methods.name: get_svc
methods.description: Returns the service type.

methods.name: get_ep_for_dst_svc
methods.description: Gets SSL socket for destination service.

methods.name: get_listener_socket
methods.description: Gets listener socket for a service.

methods.name: close_listener_socket
methods.description: Closes the specified listener socket.

methods.name: copy_bus_event
methods.description: Copies a bus event into the command module.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes command execution environment.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Destroys command execution environment.

methods.name: send_cmd
methods.description: Sends a command to a specified service.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command of a specific type to a service (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_port_from_dst_service
methods.description: Gets port number from destination service type.

methods.name: get_path_from_dst_service
methods.description: Gets socket path from destination service type.

methods.name: load_params_file
methods.description: Loads parameters from a file into a buffer.

methods.name: release_wait
methods.description: Releases wait state.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for specified time.

methods.description: Default constructor for em_cmd_exec_t.

methods.description: Destructor for em_cmd_exec_t.
